findings.description: The managed record undercounts the hooks the sessions carried. Every one of the proof run's 150 sessions carried a SessionStart hook response, which RUNBOOK.md's shakedown row attributes to the managed plugin, yet mvp-proof.json and mvp-proof.md record 0 managed hooks: Claude.managed reads hooks only from hooks/hooks.json under an installed managed-scope plugin's installPath and from the host's managed settings file, and the plugin's hook is declared where neither read reaches. AC9 and the README state the record gives how many managed hooks the sessions carried. Fixing it needs the plugin's hook location confirmed in the eval config directory, which this review may not read, and regenerating the proof record's counts and fingerprint from that directory; both wait on the user.
